about: Place-name abbreviations (BI-094, loop B108): Intl, Natl, Univ, Med, Mem, Elem, Comm, Dept inside a name (a capitalised word on either side, or 'of' then one) and Hosp, Sch, Arpt, Inc, Corp, Co ending one (a name, 'and' or a comma before) are said in full; a period inside a name goes, one that may end the sentence stays. Negatives: lowercase 'med school'/'inc', 'Co Rd' (county road), 'Weld Co Sheriff' (maybe a county), 'the Univ' (no name), all caps. Backseat Driver: backseat::pronunciation::ForSpeech / PlaceNameWords (libs/backseat/backseat_tests/spoken_place_names.json).
